completed: Preserved runnable incumbent strategy/engine and early-scanner source alongside the isolated 52-configuration workbench.
Verified 50 target integration tests and 357 isolated workbench tests; original strategy functions and synthetic weight matrices match.
Verified one status-only Slack receipt and the new guarded scheduler; the old KeepAlive service is disabled.
Evaluated eight frozen new factor/control configurations: one base-only joint pass, zero base-plus-stress passes; all 60 configurations remain disclosed.
Evaluated six separately registered covariance/diversification and trend hypotheses; no joint primary pass among 66 completed configurations.
Evaluated six implementation-stability and fixed-mixture configurations; two pass the latest primary goals in both windows and both base/stress scenarios. All 72 configurations remain disclosed.

Independent equity and metric audit confirms all 20 new configurations and 162 original/additional paths. The growth/gold plus minimum-variance ensemble has base Sharpe 1.187/1.105 and stress Sharpe 1.137/1.016.
The ensemble still has approximately 20% drawdown; 50bp costs and some rolling windows fail. No selection-adjusted alpha, independent forward result or live trading authority is claimed.
Preregistered six aggregate-risk and actual-holdings turnover controls, raising the registered count to78; the72 previously evaluated configurations and the qualified incumbent remain unchanged.
completed_zh: 已保留可运行的原Top30算法、成本引擎和独立早期扫描器，并隔离导入52配置研究工作台。
目标整合50项测试及独立研究357项测试通过；原算法函数与五组完整合成权重矩阵保持等价。
已验证一条仅状态Slack回执及新定时任务；旧常驻心跳服务已停用，未改变持仓或Discord任务。
已评估8个冻结新因子及对照：基础情景联合通过1个，基础及压力联合通过0个；累计60个配置全部保留。
已评估第二轮6个协方差分散及趋势假设，无联合通过；累计完成66个配置。
第三轮6个配置评估完成，2个通过最新两项目标的双窗口基础及压力门槛；全部72个配置保留，尚未满足旧回撤上限。
独立账本与指标复算确认20个新配置及162条原始/追加路径；成长黄金与最小方差组合基础Sharpe为1.187/1.105，压力为1.137/1.016。
组合回撤仍约20%；50bp成本及部分滚动窗口失败，尚无经多重选择修正的alpha或独立前瞻证明，不产生实盘权限。
另行预注册6个组合风险及实际持仓调仓控制，累计登记78个；之前72个已评估配置及达标基线均保持不变。
